pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch geometry on the upper neck is predominantly quadrangular and pentangular, while regions on the lower neck and shoulder exhibit reduced edge sharpness due to focal blur.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial network forming distinct tri-point and quad-point junction nodes. Pathways maintain relatively uniform pixel thickness across the neck region, though definition decreases in out-of-focus areas of the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D geometric contour along the upper neck mane, presenting a dense and jagged silhouette against the background.
